hero.headline: Your building's cabling should be the last thing you worry about.
hero.sub: WITS designs and installs structured cabling, fiber, and IT rooms for commercial buildings around Orlando. Thirty years in the field, fifteen running this business, and every run labeled and documented so the next person to open the closet can read it.
hero.image-alt: A fiber tester connected to a network switch during commissioning.

services.card-1-body: Copper backbone and horizontal runs for offices, suites, and full floors. Every drop labeled at both ends and recorded on a plan you keep.
services.card-2-body: Single-mode and multimode between closets, floors, and buildings. Terminated, tested, and handed over together with the results.
services.card-3-body: Racks, pathways, grounding, and cable management laid out before anything gets pulled — so the room is still workable in five years.

why-us.intro: You should be able to open the closet in five years and still know what every cable does.
why-us.point-1-body: Every run installed to be opened and understood five years from now, not just to pass today.
why-us.point-2-body: Labeling at both ends and a record of the plant that outlives whoever installed it.
why-us.point-3-body: Thirty years in the trade, fifteen years running this business — the same person who quotes the job is the one who comes back to it.
why-us.point-4-body: The same contact through quoting, install and anything after.
why-us.point-5-body: Written scope agreed in advance, so variations are visible rather than argued about later.

contact.headline: Call for an estimate.
contact.sub: Tell us what the building needs. We walk the site, then put the scope, the schedule, and the price in writing.
